problem: Which U.S. states had a percentage of alcohol-impaired-driving traffic fatalities higher than 35% in 2022 according to the NHTSA’s Traffic Safety Facts report, and also had an excessive drinking rate above 20% in 2022 based on data from WorldPopulationReview.com?
answer: New Hampshire, South Carolina, Ohio, Illinois, Oregon, Rhode Island
